verification_pass.scope: 8 critical blockers + HIGH-001/005/008/013 re-validated against source by 3 parallel agents
headline: CRIT-004 is a FALSE POSITIVE (safety mapping exists in config.ts) — rejected
CRIT-001 is OVERSTATED (only tokenless caller is gateway-openapi, never serves) — downgraded to Low
HIGH-005 is PARTIAL — only work.tsx was a real crash; fixed this pass
HIGH-001 wildcard-allowlist clause is a FALSE POSITIVE; the DNS-rebinding TOCTOU is real

findings.title: Auth silently disabled when create_gateway_app called without auth_token
findings.notes: Only tokenless caller is gateway-openapi which never binds a socket; served daemon always resolves a token. Keep as defense-in-depth, not a release blocker.

findings.title: Authoring workflow non-functional: Generate has no onClick, Apply/Revert are explicit stubs
findings.notes: authoring_apply/revert return {ok:true} no-ops (cli/main.py:694-714); no generatePatch store action.

findings.title: Skills kennel Browse button is a confirmed noop
findings.notes: Empty onClick at skills.tsx:205; working install path is per-card addSkill(). Fix is Trivial-to-Medium.

findings.title: Safety level names mismatched frontend-to-backend — changes silently ignored
findings.notes: Bidirectional mapping adaptTier/safetyToTier exists in config.ts:78-90 and is wired into load+persist. Convert GATE-07 to a regression test.

findings.title: Python sandbox executor: full host filesystem access and unrestricted network egress
findings.notes: Real, but only reachable in 'unrestricted' tier (sandbox/guided raise PermissionError). Tool description 'secure sandbox' is misleading. Interim env-gate+AST fix is Medium; true isolation Large.

findings.title: No session ownership enforcement — any bearer token can read/inject any session
findings.notes: No owner/principal binding anywhere in gateway/. Severity bounded by single-tenant/loopback but real for any exposed/multi-user deploy.

findings.title: Session resume --resume/--continue silently drops context and starts fresh
findings.notes: cli/main.py:1860-1864 warns then _launch_cockpit() fresh, exit 0. Dead resolver _resolve_resume_target at :1793. Gateway _boot_session_agent also ignores session_id.

findings.title: Two-terminal setup blocks the first-value path; no single-process serve
findings.notes: No serve command; README:353-363 mandates hachi gateway + npm run dev. Fix: mount frontend/dist via StaticFiles.

findings.title: DNS rebinding TOCTOU window in net_guard (wildcard-allowlist clause is false)
findings.notes: TOCTOU confirmed (net_guard.py:61-72 resolves but does not pin IP). 'Wildcard allowlist' is a false positive — net_guard has no allowlist.

Division-by-zero / TypeError on empty new-user data in Work spend view
findings.notes: work.tsx hit maxCum.toFixed on undefined (hard crash). FIXED this pass: guards + empty-state. index.tsx clamped, og.tsx guarded — both cosmetic, dropped to Low.
